configurePresets.name: gcc-debug
configurePresets.description: Default for the edit-build-test loop. Non-ASan: cold build ~137s vs ~204s for gcc-debug-asan, and the suite runs ~4x faster (6s vs 24s). PCH + ccache + mold auto-enabled. Built at -Og, not -O0: costs ~6% build time and a few scalar locals that gdb reports as <optimized out>, buys a 3x faster suite and GCC's dataflow warnings (-Wmaybe-uninitialized and friends), which -O0 cannot emit at all. For a session where you need every local materialized, reconfigure one build dir with -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG="-g -ftrivial-auto-var-init=pattern".

configurePresets.name: gcc-release
configurePresets.description: Optimized build for benchmarking and release-perf checks (non-ASan).

configurePresets.name: gcc-debug-asan
configurePresets.description: Use before committing or when chasing a crash/UB (use-after-free, leaks, OOB). NOT the default iteration build: ASan adds ~50% to a cold build and makes the suite ~4x slower (24s vs 6s).

buildPresets.name: gcc-debug
buildPresets.description: Recommended iteration build. Concurrent compiles are capped adaptively (physical cores + RAM, <=16) via the solux_compile Ninja pool in CMakeLists, so a plain -j is safe here and on smaller laptops.
